name: Zebedee
overview: Zebedee is identified in Scripture as the father of James and John, two of Jesus’ disciples, who were called by Jesus while mending their nets in a boat with their father (Matthew 4:21; Mark 1:20). The passages also indicate the family's presence and recognition among Jesus’ followers, as seen when the mother of Zebedee's children approaches Jesus seeking a favor (Matthew 20:20) and is mentioned among the women at the crucifixion (Matthew 27:56). These verses highlight Zebedee’s role as a father within the early circle of Jesus’ ministry and provide context for the calling of his sons.
